verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕਰਿ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: prem bhagat jaidheau kar geet govi(n)dh sahaj dhun gaavai|

en.bdb: Getting immersed in the loving devotion, the devotee Jaidev would sing the songs of the Lord (Govind).

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੀਲਾ ਚਲਿਤ ਵਖਾਣਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: leelaa chalit vakhaanadhaa a(n)tarajaamee Thaakur bhaavai|

en.bdb: He would describe the glorious feats accomplished by God and was greatly loved by him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਆਵੜੈ ਪੁਸਤਕੁ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: akhar ik na aavaRai pusatak ba(n)neh sa(n)dhiaa kar aavai|

en.bdb: He (Jaidev) knew no would and hence binding his book would return home in the evening.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਭਗਤ ਰੂਪਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਬਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gun nidhaan ghar aai kai bhagat roop likh lekh banaavai|

en.bdb: God, the repository of all virtues in the form of the devotee Himself wrote all the songs for him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨ ਅੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: akhar paReh parateet kar hoi visamaadh na a(n)g samaavai|

en.bdb: Jaidev would get elated seeing and reading those words.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਜਾਇ ਉਜਾੜਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: vekhai jai ujaaR vich birakh ik aacharaj suhaavai|

en.bdb: Jaidev saw a wonderful tree in the deep forest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਪੂਰਣੋ ਪਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: geet govi(n)dh sa(n)poorano pat pat likhiaa a(n)t na paavai|

en.bdb: Each and every leaf had the songs of the Lord Govind written on it. He could not understand this mystery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat het paragaas kar hoi dhiaal milai gal laavai|

en.bdb: Due to the love for the devotee, God embraced him in person.
God and saint have no veil in between.
